description: This PHP source file defines the class 'actionCreateRecord' which extends 'actionBase'. It provides methods for loading JavaScript, displaying an edit interface for creating records, executing the create record action, setting record fields, managing relationships, copying email addresses, and validating email addresses within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment.

classes.name: actionCreateRecord
classes.description: Class for creating and managing record creation actions within SuiteCRM, including setting fields, relationships, and copying email addresses.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript file path associated with this action.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates HTML for the record creation form, including fields for record type, relationships, and email copying options.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the creation of a new record based on provided parameters, including setting fields and relationships.

methods.name: set_record
methods.description: Populates a record's fields based on parameters, handling various data types and date calculations, then saves the record.

methods.name: set_relationships
methods.description: Establishes relationships between the new record and existing beans based on parameters.

methods.name: copyEmailAddresses
methods.description: Copies email addresses from one bean to another, validating email addresses.

methods.name: validateCurrentEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates the structure of an email address array.
